animals.description: A cute furry pet that says meow!
A loyal pet that says woof!
A pink farm animal that says oink!
A clever animal with a bushy tail!
A wise night bird that hoot-hoots!
A farm bird that lays eggs!

food.description: A crunchy red fruit that grows on trees!
A sweet green fruit shaped like a teardrop!
A yellow fruit that monkeys love to eat!
A sweet treat with candles for birthdays!
A healthy white drink from cows!
An oval food that hen lays!

objects.description: A small vehicle with four wheels to drive!
A big yellow vehicle for school kids!
You drink water or milk from this!
Something you wear on your head to block the sun!
A square cardboard package to hold toys!
A round toy that you bounce and kick!

colors.description: The color of fire trucks and ripe apples!
The color of the sky on a sunny day!
The color of grass and leafy trees!
The color of the bright hot sun!
The color of sweet cotton candy and pigs!

actions.description: Moving very fast on your feet!
Springing up high off the ground!
Soaring through the air like a bird!
Moving step by step at a nice slow pace!
Moving through water like a little fish!

space.description: A glowing light in the night sky!
A bright circle or crescent in the night sky!
A spaceship that blasts off into space!
Our closest bright yellow star that makes the day warm!
A flying saucer with friendly aliens!
